motivation: bridge the L30 gap between the 721858-parameter CNN accuracy route and the 34-parameter Sparse16 route
development_sessions: first five acquisition sessions in archive order
sealed_historical_replay_sessions: last three acquisition sessions in archive order

candidate_selection.one_um_tie_rule: among candidates within 1 um of the minimum development CV error, select the fewest fitted parameters, then lexical candidate id

preprocessing.compact_mlp: training-only feature and target standardization; predictions transformed back to micrometres

decision_boundary: L26 plus L24 remains a separate 12-label calibrated route and cannot be ranked in the zero-calibration replay track
